purpose: Provide a reproducible comparison framework for testing whether xAI Colossus 2 received materially different permitting, enforcement, public-participation, or federal-intervention treatment than similarly situated private generation or data-center projects.
prohibited_inference: No disparate-treatment, novelty, discriminatory-intent, or exceptional-favor conclusion may be promoted from this framework until comparable projects are populated with primary records and scored under the same rules.
unit_of_comparison: One private data-center or industrial project using on-site combustion generation at a scale capable of triggering major-source, preconstruction, aggregation, or equivalent state permitting review.
inclusion_criteria: Project operated or proposed at least 50 megawatts of on-site combustion generation, or a documented equivalent emissions potential.
Project required or disputed preconstruction air permitting, source aggregation, temporary-equipment classification, or comparable environmental review.
Project was located within five miles of a residential population or another reproducibly defined exposure area.
Public records exist for permit timing, equipment scope, enforcement posture, and community participation.
Project chronology overlaps 2015-2026 unless included as a historical doctrinal control.
exclusion_criteria: Emergency generators used only for short-duration reliability testing with no evidence of sustained primary-power operation.
Projects lacking sufficient records to establish capacity, fuel, operating posture, or permit chronology.
Government-owned military generation unless used specifically as a national-security-authority control.
Projects selected solely because of political salience without technical comparability.

community_demographics: predominantly Black or other historically burdened community

comparability_scale.3: closely comparable on capacity, operating role, permit issue, residential proximity, and chronology
comparability_scale.2: comparable on at least four critical dimensions with explainable differences
comparability_scale.1: near control useful for one or two doctrinal or enforcement dimensions
comparability_scale.0: not comparable and excluded from outcome inference

treatment_difference_scale.2: materially more favorable or less burdensome treatment supported by primary records
treatment_difference_scale.-1: more burdensome treatment than the target project

scoring_rules.minimum_for_disparate_treatment_review: At least three controls with comparability score 2 or 3, including at least one differently situated demographic control and one prior-administration or different-jurisdiction control.

candidate_control_slots.description: Large data center with on-site gas generation in a predominantly white residential area
Large data center with on-site gas generation in a historically burdened minority community
Industrial project where preconstruction enforcement occurred before operation
Coordinated mobile or temporary generator fleet subjected to source-aggregation review
Private infrastructure project receiving explicit federal national-security support
Comparable project under a prior federal administration

required_primary_records_per_control: signed permit and technical support documents
public notice, hearing, and comment records
court filings and orders where litigation occurred
review_boundary: The framework is complete as a method but contains no populated controls. It may support acquisition planning and prevent cherry-picking; it may not support a finding that Colossus 2 received preferential, discriminatory, unlawful, or unprecedented treatment.
